mechanism: Exact Fourier Parseval reduces uniform-prior least-trit advantage to the squared multiplicities of informative native word offsets. A unit-minor population calculation bounds this energy independently of ANY full-label-dependent collective initial diagonal phase, including partial-block quadratics and top-digit phases. Independent word permutations and label-dependent affine maps also cannot evade the population envelope.
research_decision: Do not scan more single-chirp/fixed-Fourier receivers at the underfull batch. Seek an explicit noncommuting mixer, label-dependent nonlinear word map or a costed larger-batch readout with an efficient decoder. The latter remains open: polynomial surplus samples are not forbidden by this bound.
falsifiers: Complete raw physical success exceeds the exact per-label offset-energy envelope.
Composite-root population moments disagree with complete source censuses or omit inactive-coordinate multiplicities.
Nonlinear label-independent permutation signature routing exceeds the identity expectation.
The theorem is misapplied to a label-dependent nonlinear map, a different source law, an earlier noncommuting mixer or extra secret-bearing inputs.

proof_obligations.PO-REVIEW: Review the uniform-prior nuisance projection, both Fourier Parseval factors, zero-sum three-vector inequality and Jensen step.
proof_obligations.PO-MOMENT: Use native simplex transition minors over Z_(3^r), including the unit2 mixed-sign case for permutation signatures. Do not substitute an IID random graph or a prime field.
proof_obligations.PO-PHASE: The initial phase can depend on every public label and entangle all words. Independent public phase coins are conditioned on; they do not prove a changed source is IID.
proof_obligations.PO-PERMUTATION: General word permutations are fixed independently of random native labels. Only the invertible affine subclass has exact output relabeling even when label-dependent.
proof_obligations.PO-ROUTING: A surviving label-dependent nonlinear route must supply mean phase-weighted offset energy at least (9/2)*epsilon^2*D^2. A uniform multiplicity cap below 9*epsilon^2*D*G/(4*(D-1)) cannot support the target advantage. This is necessary, not sufficient; do not assume independence between the maximum multiplicity and the edge count.
proof_obligations.PO-PRIOR: Every secret coordinate and high digit is uniform. This is a mean-secret advantage bound, not preservation of individual pure states or pointwise hardness.
proof_obligations.PO-BATCH: Use the actual complete native batch. M=n*r-2 gives exponential suppression, but larger polynomial sample budgets can make the gate vacuous.
proof_obligations.PO-DECODER: The bound grants arbitrary classical postprocessing. Exact MAP in physical calibrations is exponential and not an efficient supplied decoder.
proof_obligations.PO-FAILURE: All Born outcomes and consumed sources remain in the raw score; do not promote postselected conditional success.
proof_obligations.PO-SCOPE: Multiple phase/mixing layers, label-dependent nonlinear word maps, arbitrary label-aware POVMs and other source laws require separate arguments.
proof_obligations.PO-NOVELTY: This is a restricted receiver exclusion, not a new quantum algorithm or a generic quantum lower bound. Novelty is unreviewed.
